title: Instagram’s latest feature lets you add tagged posts to your profile grid | TechCrunch
summary: You can add a tagged post to your grid from the DM notification you receive when you’re tagged, directly from the post itself, or through your Tagged tab. Instagram has also been adding new tools to make creating and managing content easier.
